requirements.title: FILE_STORAGE_SIZE gives the file storage unit size in bits
requirements.source: S16.10.2.11 p1 value relation; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF474.
requirements.definition: FILE_STORAGE_SIZE is a default integer scalar constant whose value is the size in bits of the file storage unit.

pending.file-storage-size-default-integer-scalar: Import FILE_STORAGE_SIZE, assert KIND(FILE_STORAGE_SIZE) equals KIND(0), RANK(FILE_STORAGE_SIZE) equals 0, and assignment changes a -777 sentinel; mutate the imported name to CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE.
pending.file-storage-size-positive-bit-count: Assert FILE_STORAGE_SIZE > 0 as a bit count and mutate the comparison to >= 0 so a zero-valued bug is load-bearing.

requirements.title: The file storage unit bit count is processor dependent
requirements.source: S16.10.2.11 p1 cross-reference to 12.3.5; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF474.
requirements.definition: The standard fixes FILE_STORAGE_SIZE as the bit count of the file storage unit, while the actual file storage-unit size is processor dependent.

pending.file-storage-unit-size-processor-depende: No portable oracle may require a particular FILE_STORAGE_SIZE numeric value; future fixtures assert positivity and avoid byte-count assumptions.
